name: The `silo` command
what: Every feature is reached from the `silo` command on your Mac from the day it is built. It prints plain text for a person and one JSON line per item with `--json`, so both you and your agents can query the record with ordinary tools. Inside a computer it reads only what that computer may read.

suggest.why: It gives both you and your agents scriptable text and JSONL access to Silo from the first feature built.
